# Eunomia Pharma Services

> Boutique healthcare compliance consultancy for pharmaceutical and biotech companies, registered in the UK (Woking) and delivering globally. We design commercial compliance frameworks and operationalise them: programme design and audit readiness, compliance automation, local legal mandates and representation, and shared compliance services (GBS/GCC). 20+ companies worked with, 30 countries covered, 4.9 rating on Clutch.

Eunomia Pharma Services is a trading name of Mivigilance Limited, registered in England and Wales (company number 12912269). Registered office: Rough Way, Heath House Road, Woking, GU22 0QU. Contact: hello@eunomiapharmaservices.com, +44 7584 567018.

## Services

- [Healthcare Compliance Programme Design and Implementation](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/governance-assurance): Frameworks, controls, ABPI Code compliance support, ABAC risk assessment, policies, training, monitoring and audit readiness.
- [Automation of Compliance Operations](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/automation-of-compliance-operations): Compliance workflows, EFPIA disclosure data and monitoring built with SharePoint, Power BI and controlled AI.
- [Local Legal Mandates and Representation](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/local-legal-mandates): Named in-market compliance support, local-code interpretation and market-entry assessments.
- [Shared Services / GBS / GCC](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/shared-services): Outsourced compliance operations including materials review, HCP fair market value and EFPIA disclosure.

Specialist UK services within Programme Design and Implementation:

- [Pharmaceutical compliance training in the UK](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/governance-assurance/pharma-compliance-training): Bespoke ABPI Code, anti-bribery and HCP engagement training by role.
- [Pharmaceutical risk assessment services in the UK](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/governance-assurance/pharma-risk-assessment): ABAC, fraud and commercial compliance risk assessments with owned actions.
- [SOP and policy development for pharma in the UK](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/governance-assurance/sop-policy-development): Practical compliance policies and SOPs mapped to real workflows.
- [Pharma compliance audits in the UK](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/services/governance-assurance/pharma-compliance-audits): ABPI Code and commercial compliance audits, gap analysis and CAPA.

## Country guides

Each guide summarises national law and industry codes, with links to official sources.

- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Germany](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/germany): FSA codes, the HWG, §§ 299a–299b StGB and transparency.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in France](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/france): Anti-gift regime, Loi Bertrand / Transparence Santé, ANSM advertising visas, Sapin II and LEEM.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Spain](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/spain): RDL 1/2015 incentives rules, RD 1416/1994 advertising and hospitality, the Farmaindustria Code and disclosure.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Italy](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/italy): D.Lgs. 219/2006 gifts and AIFA congress notification, the Farmindustria Code, the Sunshine Act (Legge 62/2022) and D.Lgs. 231/2001.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in the Netherlands](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/netherlands): Geneesmiddelenwet Article 94, IGJ gift limits, the CGR code, Transparantieregister Zorg and KOAG/KAG.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Portugal](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/portugal): INFARMED transparency declarations, advertising and the APIFARMA code.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Ireland](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/ireland): HPRA advertising oversight, the IPHA Code and disclosure.
- [Pharmaceutical compliance in Sweden](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/markets/sweden): Swedish Medical Products Agency advertising rules, Lif ethical rules (LER) and disclosure.
- [Legal mandates overview](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/legal-mandates): The laws and industry codes behind pharmaceutical compliance, with official sources.

## Case studies

- [Fair Market Value Methodology for HCP Compensation](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/fair-market-value-methodology): Five-market FMV methodology, tiering and rate cards.
- [Pharmaceutical Materials Review: Shared Services Case Study](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/materials-review-shared-service-case-study): Structured review service for a UK company expanding across Europe.

## Article topics

- [EFPIA Code Compliance](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/efpia-code-compliance): Applying the EFPIA Code and national codes to interactions with healthcare professionals, organisations and patient groups.
- [ABPI Code & PMCPA](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/abpi-code-pmcpa): UK promotional compliance under the ABPI Code of Practice and PMCPA guidance and cases.
- [GDPR & Data Compliance in Pharma](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/gdpr-data-compliance): Data protection and data governance for pharmaceutical compliance.
- [HCP Engagement & Transparency Reporting](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/hcp-engagement-transparency): Fair market value, transfers of value and disclosure under EFPIA and national transparency laws.
- [Regulatory Updates & Compliance News](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/regulatory-updates): New guidance, legislation and developments affecting pharmaceutical compliance.
- [Third-Party Due Diligence & Supply Chain Compliance](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/third-party-due-diligence): Managing compliance risk in distributors, vendors and other third parties.
- [Compliance Programmes, Audits & Training](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/compliance-programmes): Designing, auditing and embedding healthcare compliance programmes, policies and training.
- [AI & Digital Compliance](https://www.eunomiapharmaservices.com/resources/category/ai-digital-compliance): AI governance, automation and data analytics in healthcare compliance.
